title: Victorian Turret House with Palm Tree, 1930s B&W Snapshot Photo
back_text_transcription:
See way up
there? That's part
of our living room
Where the roof
slopes way down -
that's our hall -
it runs the length
of the house.

499K
description: A close-up architectural snapshot of an eclectic Victorian or Queen Anne style residence, featuring a prominent multi-sided turret with a pointed conical roof and finial, dark shingled or wood siding, a second-story balcony with railings, and a leaded lattice window on the lower level. A palm tree frond frames the right side against a bright sky, suggesting a warm coastal setting such as California. On the reverse, handwritten notes detail the interior layout for the recipient, explaining the location of the living room and long central hall.
